name: Witching Hour
summary:
In folklore, the witching hour is a time of night that is associated with supernatural events, whereby witches, demons and ghosts are thought to appear and be at their most powerful...

Witching Hour is a set of 8 maps (+1 unbeatable finale map) for Doom 2 that will take you through dark forests, rotting bogs, lost tombs and forgotten temples. The maps aren't long and overall it might take around an hour to beat. The difficulty ranges from moderate to very hard, though you won't need to be a Doom god. Difficulty levels are supported and will reign in the challenge significantly.
